 1 | Muscle Lore | 1 target | - | touch | I

19 | Mass Tendon Repair | varies | P | touch | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster acquires a complete understanding of any muscle damage, including the
tools and methods required for healing; caster does not receive the skill or
power to perform the cure.
@@ 2
As Muscle Lore, except the knowledge obtained concerns the healing of tendon
damage.
@@ 3
Allows caster to repair (not replace) 1 sprain; recovery time: 1 hour.
@@ 4
Allows caster to repair, but not replace, 1 damaged muscle. Recovery time is 1
hour.
@@ 5
Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed).
Also requires use of same spells from Nerve Law, Bone Law, and Blood Law.
@@ 6
Allows caster to repair one damaged tendon; recovery time: 1 hour.
@@ 9
As Muscle Repair I, except caster can repair 3 damaged muscles.
@@ 10
As Tendon Repair I, except caster can repair 3 damaged tendons.
@@ 12
Allows caster to reattach limb, but requires use of Bone Law, Blood Law, and
Nerve Law Joining spells in order to restore functional status; limb is fully
functional in 1-10 days.
@@ 13
As Muscle Repair I, except recovery is instantaneous and requires 1 minute
“operation” (concentration by caster).
@@ 15
As Tendon Repair I, except recovery is instantaneous and requires 1 minute
“operation” (concentration by caster).
@@ 17
Allows repair of 1 muscle per level of the caster (e.g., a 17th level caster
can repair 17 muscles); spell can be used as long as caster concentrates
(i.e., caster can move from target to target until he has healed a number of
muscles equal to his level); recovery time: 1 hour.
@@ 19
As Mass Muscle Repair, except caster heals tendons.
@@ 20
Allows caster to regenerate 1 muscle; regrowth takes 1-10 hrs, depending on
extent of loss.
@@ 25
As Joining, except limb is fully functional in 10 minutes (provided caster
also uses the other three Joining True spells).
@@ 30
Allows caster to regenerate 1 tendon; regrowth takes 1-10 hrs, depending on
extent of loss.
@@ 50
As Mass Muscle Repair, except any combination of muscles and tendons may be
healed, the range is 100', and recovery is instantaneous.
